This is for someone already settled into pouches, not a first purchase.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Arctic Mint
entries.blurb: Cold, clean mint in the moist Ultra pouch. 9 mg and 11 mg.
entries.body: Straight mint with the cooling pushed well past the standard line and very little sweetness carrying it. The moist Ultra pouch releases faster than dry ZYN, so flavor arrives quickly and then holds level. Made only at 9 mg and 11 mg, which puts it in experienced territory. If you are still deciding whether pouches suit you, start with standard ZYN instead.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Chill Mist
entries.blurb: Unflavored with cooling only. Cold sensation, nothing to taste.
entries.body: Chill Mist has no flavor in it. What you get is the cooling agent and the moist pouch feel, nothing else, which some people prefer once flavors start wearing on them. Between this and Signature Smooth, this is the cold one. Sold at 9 mg and 11 mg only, so it assumes you are already used to higher-strength pouches.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Citrus Zest
entries.blurb: Peel-forward citrus, sharper and less sweet than standard ZYN Citrus.
entries.body: More peel than juice. Sharper and drier than the standard Citrus pouch, with a bitter edge that keeps it well clear of soda territory. The moist pouch pushes flavor out faster, so the first few minutes are the loudest. It is the only non-mint option in the Ultra range, which is most of its appeal. Available at 9 mg and 11 mg, both above beginner level.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Fresh Spearmint
entries.blurb: Sweet spearmint with Ultra-level cooling behind it.
entries.body: Spearmint's rounded sweetness with far more cooling under it than the standard version carries. That lands it between the soft mints and the cold ones and makes it the easiest Ultra flavor to spend a full hour with. The moist pouch means flavor comes early rather than building. Made at 9 mg and 11 mg only, so bring some tolerance with you.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Menthol Ice
entries.blurb: The coldest thing in the case. Sharp menthol, almost no sweetness.
entries.body: Menthol with the cooling turned all the way up and nothing sweet to blunt it. Sharp on contact, and the cold hangs on well after the flavor itself has thinned out. Not subtle, and not trying to be. Offered at 9 mg and 11 mg. If Ultra is new to you, this is the wrong flavor to open with, and most people who love it worked up to it.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Peppermint Frost
entries.blurb: Sharp peppermint over heavy cooling, finishing clean.
entries.body: Peppermint with an edge, backed by the heavier cooling the Ultra line runs. Sweeter than Menthol Ice, colder than Arctic Mint, and it finishes clean instead of hanging around. The moist pouch keeps it steady rather than front-loaded. Made at 9 mg and 11 mg, so it assumes you already know how you handle the higher strengths.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Signature Smooth
entries.blurb: Unflavored and uncooled. The plain option in the Ultra line.
entries.body: No flavor and no cooling agent, which makes it the quietest pouch Ultra builds. There is a faint neutral sweetness from the pouch itself and nothing past that. Pick it over Chill Mist if you want the moist Ultra format without any cold sensation at all. Made at 9 mg and 11 mg only, so quiet in taste does not mean mild overall.

entries.name: ZYN Ultra Wintergreen Blast
entries.blurb: Sweet wintergreen with the cooling pushed hard. 9 mg and 11 mg.
entries.body: The familiar wintergreen profile, sweeter and deeper than mint, with much more cooling behind it than standard ZYN Wintergreen carries. It stays sweet the whole way through instead of drying out at the end. Wintergreen tends to be the Ultra flavor people come back for. Made at 9 mg and 11 mg only, which is well past where anyone should begin.

entries.name: ZYN Wintergreen
entries.blurb: Sweet wintergreen with a cool finish. The familiar classic.
entries.body: The most familiar flavor in the case for anyone who came over from dip. Sweet wintergreen with that deeper root-beer-adjacent note behind it and a cooling finish softer than menthol. Strong enough to notice all the way through, never harsh. Stocked in 3 mg and 6 mg, which makes it one of the few classics you can take either mild or firm depending on the day.
